title: Drash, Skad and their Gang
description: Boba Fett and Fennec Shand head into the city to deal with Lortha Peel's gang problem. On the streets of Mos Espa, Fett finds the cybernetically modified crew, and questions them about the stolen water. Freely admitting the theft, the gang suggests that Peel is executing the real crime, in overcharging for water. Fett, pressing the issue, begins to get a sense of how dire things are in the Workers District. When Drash tells Boba there is no work to be had, he presents the gang with an employment opportunity.
